**Rescue plan: Nuwakot district (scenario large-13)**

I did not run a solver, but I compared the main alternatives by hand and this was the cheapest plan I found. It rescues 20 of the 21 people and defers one adult.

**Constraints from the field report**
- **Drop-off points:** The only evacuation points are Kalika shelter and Dhunche hospital. Jwalamukhi school isn't designated, so people are only picked up there.
- **Unusable roads:** I avoided Kalika–Syaphru and Gosaikunda–Dupcheshwar because of floodwater, and Belkot–Gajuri because of the landslide.

**Route decisions**

| Location | People | Action | Driving | Penalty |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kakani village | 3 injured, 1 child | car1 makes one round trip from Kalika | 28 | 0 |
| Jwalamukhi school | 3 injured, 2 children | car2 makes one round trip from Dhunche, and takes the last child on the Naukunda trip | 18 | 0 |
| Naukunda market | 3 adults | car2 extends its second Jwalamukhi trip to Naukunda | 54 | 0 |
| Gosaikunda village | 4 injured, 3 children, 2 adults | car2 makes two round trips from Dhunche and 1 adult is deferred | 92 | 20 |

**Alternatives that cost more**
- **Deferring the last Gosaikunda adult:** A third round trip would cost 46 minutes, while the penalty is only 20.
- **Collecting the Naukunda adults:** The extension adds 36 minutes, while deferring all three would cost 60.
- **Using car1 for Naukunda:** Having car1 collect the adults after Kakani and finish at Dhunche would raise the combined cost of Kakani, Jwalamukhi and Naukunda from 100 to 105.

unload car1 injured 3

unload car2 injured 3

drive car2 gosaikunda-village dhunche-hospital

unload car2 adult 1
drive car2 dhunche-hospital jwalamukhi-school
drive car2 jwalamukhi-school naukunda-market

**Cost breakdown:** Driving takes 192 minutes (car1 28, car2 164), and the deferred adult adds a penalty of 20.

COST: 212
